# VecraHost

> VecraHost is an Indian hosting provider based in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh. It sells KVM VPS hosting with dedicated vCPU and RAM, NVMe storage, Indian IP addresses and a 99.9% uptime target. Plans are billed in INR through the VecraHost billing portal.

## Products

- [VPS Hosting](https://vecrahost.in/vps): Linux virtual private servers in India with dedicated resources, NVMe SSD storage, full root access and instant provisioning. Current plans and INR prices are listed on this page.
- [Web Hosting](https://vecrahost.in/web-hosting): Shared web hosting for business websites. Coming soon.
- [Domains](https://vecrahost.in/domains): Domain registration with transparent renewal pricing. Coming soon.

## Support

- [Contact and support](https://vecrahost.in/contactus): Submit a support or sales request; the team replies by email from support@vecrahost.in.
- [Billing portal](https://portal.vecrahost.in): Order servers, manage services and pay invoices.
